{{dablink|For other uses of the word "blue," see [[Blue]].}}
'''The Blue Cat''' is an inn located in [[Tar Valon]], not far from the Great Fish Market in the southwest part of the city. The inn is actually built in the shape of a large, sleeping cat, and is of [[Ogier]] design and construction.

It was passed by [[Moiraine Damodred]] and [[Siuan Sanche]] on their way out of the city to disburse the [[Amyrlin Seat]]'s bounty to all newborn infants on the day after the [[Dragon Reborn|Dragon]]'s rebirth in late {{ne|978}}.{{ref/book|0|4}}
